info.title: Kanakku API
info.description: Expense splitting for friends, trips and flatmates.

200.description: My profile
The saved profile, with its new version

409.description: Stale version

200.description: The saved profile; the number is unverified until a code confirms it

409.description: Stale version, or the number is verified on another account (phone-taken)

429.description: Ten saves an hour per user and thirty per address (too-many-codes); see Retry-After

200.description: The saved profile, with no number

409.description: Stale version

put.summary: Set, change or clear a guest's phone number (Owner only)

200.description: The guest, with the number masked

409.description: Not a guest, stale version, or the group is archived

post.summary: Text a verification code to my number

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A fresh value per submit attempt

202.description: A code was made; smsSent is false if the provider failed

409.description: No SMS provider (sms-not-configured), no number, already verified, or phone-taken

429.description: Four codes an hour per user and per number, ten per address, or the server's hourly ceiling (too-many-codes, sms-busy); see Retry-After

post.summary: Confirm the code I was texted

200.description: My profile, with the number verified

429.description: Five wrong codes lock this for 15 minutes (code-locked); see Retry-After

post.summary: See which group and guest an invite is for

200.description: The group name and the guest name

post.summary: Take over a guest's place with an invite

200.description: The group the caller has joined

403.description: The invite was made for another account (invite-for-someone-else)

409.description: The caller is already in the group, or the group is archived

get.summary: List the groups I belong to

200.description: My groups, newest first

post.summary: Create a group; the caller becomes its Owner

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A fresh value per submit attempt

422.description: Idempotency-Key reused with a different body

post.summary: Search users by name, email or phone to add or invite (Owner only)

200.description: At most 10 matches, members left out; each shows the one masked field it matched

400.description: The query is under 3 characters, or under 4 digits for a phone search

429.description: More than 20 searches in a minute; see Retry-After

post.summary: Invite a found user with a guest and a single-use invite (Owner only)

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A fresh value per submit attempt

201.description: The invite and its token (shown once). The user is not a member until they claim it.

404.description: No such group, or no such user

409.description: Already a member, or the group is archived

post.summary: Unarchive a group (Owner only)

200.description: The reopened group

409.description: Stale version, or the group is not archived

get.summary: List a group's members with their balances

200.description: Current members, oldest first

404.description: No such group, or I am not in it

post.summary: Add a registered user directly (Owner only)

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A fresh value per submit attempt

409.description: Already a member, invite-only, or the group is archived. A phone number, verified or not, never blocks an add

post.summary: Write off a member's balance onto chosen members (Owner only)

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A fresh value per submit attempt

201.description: What was written off, per currency

400.description: The absorbers are empty, repeat, include the member, or are not members

post.summary: Leave the group (not the Owner)

409.description: member-has-balance (lists the amounts), last-owner or group-archived

200.description: Newest first; never includes a token

post.summary: Create a single-use invite for a guest (Owner only)

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A fresh value per submit attempt

201.description: The invite and its token (shown once)

400.description: Expiry is not 1, 7 or 30 days, or Idempotency-Key is missing

post.summary: Revoke an invite (Owner only)

200.description: The revoked invite

409.description: Stale version, or the invite was already used or revoked

post.summary: Add a guest (a name, optionally an email and a phone number)

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A fresh value per submit attempt

409.description: The group is archived

post.summary: Archive a group (Owner only)

200.description: The archived group

409.description: Stale version

post.summary: Not me: leave the guest alone

200.description: The suggestion, now DECLINED

409.description: Stale version or already answered

post.summary: It is me: move the guest's balance onto my own row and retire the guest

200.description: The suggestion, now CONFIRMED

409.description: Stale version, already answered, the guest is gone or the group is archived

post.summary: Confirm the SMS code and create the account

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A fresh value per submit attempt

201.description: Account created with a verified number (shown masked). No session is started.

409.description: The email or the number got an account first (email-taken, phone-taken)

410.description: The sign-up expired (sign-up-expired) or the code did (code-expired)

429.description: Five wrong codes lock this number for 15 minutes (code-locked)

post.summary: Text a new code for a pending sign-up

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A fresh value per submit attempt

202.description: A new code was made; smsSent is false if the provider failed

429.description: Four texts an hour per number, ten per address, or the server's hourly ceiling; see Retry-After

post.summary: Create the account with the number unverified, skipping the code

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A fresh value per submit attempt

201.description: Account created; the number stays unverified (shown masked). No session is started.

409.description: The email is taken

post.summary: Create a password account

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A fresh value per submit attempt

201.description: Account created (no phone, or no SMS provider); the number is shown masked. No session is started; call sign-in next.

202.description: An SMS code was sent and no account exists yet; confirm it with verifySignUp

409.description: Email already registered, or the number is verified on another account

422.description: Idempotency-Key reused with a different body

429.description: Too busy: this IP has too many sign-ins or sign-ups in flight, no hash slot was free in time, or too many codes were sent; see Retry-After

post.summary: Sign out and revoke the session
Sign in with email and password

200.description: Signed in; the SESSION cookie is set

401.description: Email and password do not match (one generic answer)

429.description: Too many failed tries, or this IP has too many sign-ins in flight; see Retry-After

get.summary: Read one group I belong to

200.description: The group

404.description: No such group, or I am not in it

200.description: The saved group, with its new version

409.description: Stale version, or the group is archived

get.summary: List my pending suggestions to claim a guest

200.description: Only mine, only in groups I am in, oldest first

get.summary: Whether sign-up verifies a phone number by SMS

200.description: The sign-up options
OK

delete.summary: Remove a member with no balance (Owner only)

409.description: member-has-balance (lists the amounts), last-owner, stale-version or group-archived

directAdd.description: Omit to keep the stored choice
Whether a group Owner may add me directly or I join by invite only

phone.description: My mobile number in E.164; only ever shown to me

phoneVerified.description: True once an SMS code confirmed the number

errors.description: Field errors on a 400; never contains the rejected value

retryAfterSeconds.description: Seconds until a throttled sign-in may be retried (429 only)

id.description: The member row; ledger lines name it

userId.description: The account behind this member; absent for a guest

guest.description: True until an account claims it

guestEmail.description: A guest's email, shown to the Owner only

guestPhoneMasked.description: A guest's phone number, masked, shown to the Owner only

balances.description: Non-zero balances per currency; empty when settled

amountMinor.description: Minor units; positive means owed to the member, negative means owed by

smsSent.description: False when the SMS provider did not accept the message

archivedAt.description: Set while the group is archived (read-only except settlements)

myRole.description: The caller's role in this group

maskedEmail.description: Set for a name or email match; absent for a phone match

maskedPhone.description: Set for a phone match only

phoneVerified.description: Set for a phone match only: false means anyone could have typed that number, so the picker marks it Unverified. It never blocks adding

directAdd.description: True: add directly. False: the user is invite-only, so offer Invite

userId.description: A registered user found by search

token.description: Put it in the link fragment: /invite#<token>

memberId.description: The guest this invite is for
A guest member of this group

version.description: Send back to confirm or decline

id.description: Use it for verify and resend

smsSent.description: False when the provider failed to take the text

phone.description: Mobile number. Required when the server can send SMS codes (see sign-up-options), otherwise optional and left unverified.

phoneVerification.description: True when an SMS provider is set: the phone is required and verified by a code. False: the phone is optional and stays unverified.
